magma.title: Magma Inbound Sales
magma.subtitle: Sell inbound liquidity on Amboss Magma: publish offers, track orders, and accept and fund them by hand or by policy.
magma.offNotice: Monitoring is off. The app stays installed and keeps its history, but it does not poll Amboss and will not notice a new order.
magma.monitorNotice: Monitor mode: orders are only watched and alerted on. Nothing is accepted and no channel is opened. Offers can still be edited.
magma.assistedNotice: Assisted mode: each action needs an explicit click. Nothing is accepted or funded automatically.
magma.rejectHint: Rejecting explicitly is better than letting the order lapse — Amboss records a failure against your account if you do not react.
magma.openIrreversibleHint: This broadcasts a funding transaction. The on-chain fee is paid by you and cannot be undone.
magma.backfillBody: Sales closed before this app existed carry no settlement date, so their revenue is missing from past reports while their channel-open fee was always counted.
magma.backfillScanning: Scanning settled invoices on the node…
magma.backfillInvoicesFound: Sale invoices found on the node
magma.backfillNothingFound: No sale invoices were found on this node. The historical invoices are gone, so the past cannot be dated accurately and is best left alone.
magma.backfillApplyHint: Nothing has been written yet. Applying only sets the settlement date; it does not change any report by itself.
magma.backfillRerunHint: Run this on the node to recompute the affected daily reports:
magma.offersBody: What you advertise on Magma. Amboss enforces these bounds, so no order can arrive outside them.
magma.offerBody: The global policy still applies on top of this: it can only narrow what the offer advertises, never widen it.
magma.offerConflictTitle: This offer conflicts with the policy
magma.offerConflictBody: Enabling it publishes the offer on Amboss, but the policy would refuse the orders it attracts. Those orders end as rejections or expire, and Amboss records them against the account.
magma.offerAutoDisabledHint: Needed {{required}} sat, had {{available}} sat available. It comes back on its own once the balance covers it.
magma.offerSectionLiquidityHint: Total to sell, and the smallest and largest channel a buyer may request. Leave the maximum at 0 to allow up to the total.
magma.offerSectionPriceHint: What the buyer pays you for the channel. This is the price of the sale, not a routing fee.
magma.offerSectionPromisesHint: How long the channel stays open, and the routing fees you commit not to exceed while it does.
magma.offerFixedFeeManualHint: A fixed number of sats regardless of the mempool. If fees spike, the sale can stop covering its own channel open.
magma.offerFixedFeeAutomaticHint: Amboss derives the fixed fee from the mempool at this priority, times the multiplier. The price rises with fees, so the margin holds.
magma.offerCapsRequired: Set the routing fee cap and the base fee cap before saving. 0 is allowed, but it has to be chosen: it holds every channel this offer sells at zero fee until its commitment ends.
magma.offerCapsHint: These bind the channels you sell, not the sale price. 0 means the channel routes for free for the whole commitment.
magma.offerConditionsHint: Enforced by Amboss before the order exists, which is better than rejecting it afterwards.
magma.activityBody: What the app has been doing, including decisions taken between page loads.
magma.pnlBody: Revenue counted only once the buyer's payment lands, minus the mining fee of each funding transaction.
magma.pnlReportsNote: In Reports, this revenue is added to the daily totals. The on-chain cost is not added there by Magma because the generic on-chain scan already counts it.
magma.enableAssistedConfirm: Assisted mode lets this app create invoices and open channels when you click. Each action still needs an explicit confirmation.
magma.autoNotice: Automatic mode: the policy accepts, rejects and funds orders on its own, one order per cycle. Review the limits below before leaving it running.
magma.enableAutoConfirm: Automatic mode will accept orders and open channels with no further confirmation, spending on-chain funds on its own.
magma.policyPreviewPrefix: Policy that automatic mode would use:
magma.policyBody: These limits decide which orders are accepted, rejected or postponed while automatic mode runs.
magma.policyZeroHint: Set a field to 0 to disable that limit.
magma.policyMinPricePerDayHint: Guards against a fair-looking price stretched over a long commitment.
magma.policyMinFeeCapHint: Rejects orders that would cap your own routing fee too low to be worth it.
magma.policyMaxCostPct: Maximum on-chain cost (% of the sale)
magma.policyMaxCostPctHint: Above this the order waits for cheaper fees instead of being rejected.
magma.policyReserveHint: Never spent on a sale, so fees and closings stay covered.
magma.policyMaxConcurrent: Maximum orders awaiting a channel open
magma.policyDailyOffHint: 0 turns this limit off - selling the whole offer in one day is allowed.
magma.policyAutoRejectHint: Recommended: letting an order lapse is recorded by Amboss as a seller failure.
magma.capacityBody: {{available}} sat free for new sales, out of {{confirmed}} sat confirmed.
magma.capacityCommitted: {{committed}} sat is already promised to {{count}} order(s) awaiting a channel open.

magma.tokenExpiringSoon: The Amboss API token expires in {{days}} days. Renew it in the Fee Center.
magma.statCapViolationsHint: Time spent above the fee ceiling agreed with the buyer
magma.actionNeededHint: Amboss records a failure against your account if you let these expire.
magma.noOrders: No Magma orders yet. Orders appear here after the first sync.

auth.heroBody: The admin password protects the UI and API. Internal automations such as Autofee, Rebalance, timers and succession keep running in the backend without depending on a browser session.
auth.cardProtectedBody: UI, API and terminal now require an authenticated admin session.
auth.cardRecoveryBody: Password recovery uses a one-time token generated locally on the node.
auth.cardAutomationBody: Autofee, succession and background services continue to run without extra prompts.
auth.trustDeviceBody: Install this node's public local CA once on each device. The private CA key never leaves the node.
auth.tailscaleWarningBody: .local names use LAN mDNS and normally do not resolve through Tailscale. Use a Tailscale hostname or IP included in this node's server certificate. If it is not included, the browser will still report a certificate name mismatch.
auth.trustWindowsStep1: Download the Windows installer and verify that the fingerprint matches the one shown here and in the installation console.
auth.trustWindowsStep2: Double-click the downloaded Windows launcher. It uses PowerShell Bypass for this file and keeps the result window open. Administrator access is not required.
auth.trustWindowsStep3: Restart the browser and, on the local LAN, open the preferred .local address on port 8443. For Tailscale, follow the warning above.
auth.trustDeviceNote: Linux, macOS, Android and iOS can use the CA certificate download. Their trust-store confirmation remains a device security requirement.

auth.featureAutomationBody: Autofee and node automations keep working around the clock.

lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintCooldownUp: Minimum wait before another upward fee move. Higher = slower raises; lower = faster reactions.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintCooldownDown: Minimum wait before another downward fee move. Higher = slower drops; lower = faster fee reductions.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintStepCap: Maximum fee change per round. Higher = more movement per run; lower = smoother adjustments.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintDiscoveryDownCap: Extra down-step cap used in discovery-like situations. Higher = faster unlock/down moves.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintStallRelaxGap: Minimum gap between current fee and target before stall-relax softens the floor. Lower = relaxes earlier; higher = protects floors longer.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintInboundDiscountMaxRat: Maximum inbound discount as a share of the applied outbound fee. Higher = more aggressive inbound pricing.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintInboundDiscountReachO: Highest out ratio still eligible for inbound discount. Higher = more sinks can receive discounts.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintInboundDiscountMinRet: Minimum share of outbound fee kept above the cost anchor after discount. Higher = safer margins, lower = stronger inbound discounts.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintLowFlowFloor: Floor multiplier when outbound flow is low. Higher = keeps fees higher; lower = allows lower floors.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintGlobalLockMinOut: Minimum out ratio to soften global negative-margin lock. Lower = lock softens for more channels.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintGlobalLockMaxDrop: Lowest allowed drop toward peg when global lock is softened. Lower = permits deeper cuts.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintHtlcMinAttempts: Minimum HTLC attempts needed to classify a channel. Lower = more HTLC-driven reactions.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintHtlcPolicyFailRate: Policy-failure rate threshold for HTLC signals. Lower = easier to trigger policy-hot behavior.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintHtlcLiquidityFailRate: Liquidity-failure rate threshold for HTLC signals. Lower = easier to trigger liquidity-hot behavior.

settingsHints.autoEnabled: Master switch for all automatic rebalance loops (auto scan, manual-restart watcher, and per-job restart timers). When off, no automated job creation can happen — only operator-triggered Manual Rebal In still works.
settingsHints.schedulerMode: Chooses who queues automatic jobs. In live mode, autopilot replaces rules auto and the automatic manual-restart watcher.
settingsHints.sovereignCandidateScope: Controls whether autopilot considers only auto channels or also channels marked for manual restart.
settingsHints.sovereignMaxJobsPerCycle: Maximum jobs autopilot may queue in one scan.
settingsHints.sovereignMinExpectedProfit: Minimum expected profit for a sovereign candidate. 0 allows any candidate that passes ROI/cost guardrails.
settingsHints.sovereignLowSuccessMinRate: Below this historical success rate, the target needs stronger profit/cost to be selected. Default: 1%.
settingsHints.sovereignLowSuccessMinProfitCostRatio: Expected profit divided by budget cost required for low-success targets. Default: 1.1.
settingsHints.sovereignBudgetEfficiencyMinRatio: Expected profit divided by the budget cost consumed by the rebalance. Default: 0.2.
settingsHints.sovereignRouteDeadSourceShare: Share of sources with recent structural failures that marks the target as route-dead. Default: 10%.
settingsHints.sovereignRiskScoreFloor: Lowest score multiplier for candidates with bad history. Lower values push them further down the ranking. Default: 3%.
settingsHints.sovereignGainV3ColdStartPct: Cold-start prior for gain v3: fraction of the theoretical gain kept when no revenue7d or drain-rate signal exists. Higher values let more brand-new channels survive the profit guardrail at Funnel A. Range 50–95%, default 75%. Only used when gain_model_version ≥ 3.
settingsHints.fastPathMaxTimeoutSec: Cap (seconds) for the delegated fast-path. Lower values cut dead pathfinding faster (LND exhaustively explores until timeout when no route exists), leaving more of the job budget for the legacy loop. Higher values give LND more time to find MPP routes. Range 30-300, default 90.
settingsHints.sovereignTopBucketPct: Width of the top-score bucket for fairness rotation. Candidates with score ≥ top × (1 - pct/100) are sorted by oldest LastAutoAt instead of pure score, forcing rotation among comparable candidates. Larger values = more diversity (more channels rotate); smaller = stricter score ranking. Range 5-80, default 30.
settingsHints.sovereignAttributionWindow: Main window used to attribute forwards to a rebalance. Use 72h for channels that sell over a few days.
settingsHints.sovereignSlowSellerWindow: Long window used to recognize channels that sell slowly but end profitable. Default: 168h.
settingsHints.sovereignTargetSourceQuarantine: Hours a recently rebalanced channel cannot be used as a source while paid liquidity is still unrecovered.
settingsHints.sovereignStructuralCooldownRepeat: Hours a target stays out after 2+ failed jobs (all sources failed) inside the last 24h with no success in between. Lower = retry blocked targets sooner. Default 6h.
settingsHints.sovereignExplorationSlotPct: Percentage of slots per cycle reserved for randomly chosen low-score candidates. 0 disables (default). Try 10-25 to give chronically deprioritized channels a chance.
settingsHints.sovereignEvWeightedScoring: Switches the score from gain−cost to gain×P(success)−cost×P(failure). Experimental: heavy filtering when pair stats history is noisy; keep OFF unless validating against shadow-mode data.
settingsHints.sovereignSourceOpportunityCost: Avoids draining channels that are also good targets by protecting liquidity near the target outbound.
settingsHints.sovereignSlowSellerEnabled: Allows targets with long-window profit to avoid being punished only by weak 24h results.
settingsHints.scanInterval: How often the auto engine scans channels for opportunities.
settingsHints.dailyBudgetPct: Daily spend cap as a % of routing revenue used by the selected budget mode.
settingsHints.budgetMode: Choose whether the daily budget follows only the last 24h revenue or blends 7d average with 24h revenue.
settingsHints.budgetUnlimited: Disables the daily budget guardrail for auto rebalance and manual restart. Cost, ROI, payback, cooldown, source, and concurrency guardrails still apply; spend telemetry continues to be recorded.
settingsHints.budgetAutoOnly: Apply the daily budget guardrail only to auto rebalances. Manual restart runs stay free from this budget cap.
settingsHints.manualReserveEnabled: Protects part of the daily budget so auto rebalance cannot consume it before manual restarts.
settingsHints.manualReserveMode: Reserve manual budget as a fixed sat amount or as a percent of the total daily budget.
settingsHints.manualReserveValue: Fixed sats or percent reserved for manual restart, depending on the selected reserve mode.
settingsHints.deadband: Minimum outbound deficit before a channel becomes a target.
settingsHints.sourceMinLocal: Minimum local liquidity (outbound %) required for a channel to act as source.
settingsHints.econRatio: Fraction of outbound fee used as max fee for route finding.
settingsHints.econRatioMaxPpm: Caps the max fee ppm when using econ ratio (0 = no cap).
settingsHints.feeLimitPpm: Overrides econ ratio with a fixed max fee ppm (0 = disabled).
settingsHints.lostProfit: Subtract estimated source channel fees from the max fee budget.
settingsHints.roiMin: Minimum expected ROI (7d revenue / estimated cost) to auto rebalance.
settingsHints.gainModelVersion: v1 keeps the legacy proportional revenue model. v2 estimates gain from effective spread and enables drain-rate velocity scoring. v3 combines historical revenue with drain-rate projection (7d horizon) capped by the theoretical max, with a 50% cold-start floor for new channels.
settingsHints.velocityWeight: Weight from 0 to 1 applied to the channel's real velocity signal in v2 scoring. 0 favors age/fairness; 1 favors relative drain rate.
settingsHints.autofeeSettlingWindowSec: Window in seconds after AutoFee adjusts a channel's outgoing fee during which the rebalance score is dampened. 0 disables the dampening. Default 7200 (2h).
settingsHints.autofeeSettlingMultiplier: Score multiplier applied to targets adjusted by AutoFee inside the window. 1 disables the dampening; 0.5 halves the score (recommended).
settingsHints.maxAmount: Maximum sats per rebalance attempt. 0 = no cap.
settingsHints.minSplitEnabled: When enabled, probe minimum and execution minimum are configured independently.
settingsHints.minProbeAmount: Lowest amount used by route probing while searching for capacity.
settingsHints.minExecuteAmount: Minimum amount allowed to settle a rebalance attempt when split mode is enabled.
settingsHints.mppEnabled: Enables the multi-source parallel prepass before legacy fallback.
settingsHints.mppAutoOnly: When enabled, MSPR is used only for auto jobs and manual runs stay on legacy mode.
settingsHints.mppMaxShards: Maximum number of shards per round. Higher values can improve success but increase route pressure.
settingsHints.mppParallelism: How many shard attempts can run at the same time.
settingsHints.mppMinShardSat: Minimum shard size used by MSPR when splitting amounts.
settingsHints.mppRoundTimeout: Timeout per MSPR round before falling back to legacy attempts.
settingsHints.feeSteps: Number of fee limits tried from low to high.
settingsHints.amountProbeSteps: Number of amount probes from large to small per fee step.
settingsHints.failTolerancePpm: Stop probing when amounts differ by this ppm.
settingsHints.attemptTimeout: Maximum time per attempt before moving to the next fee/amount.
settingsHints.amountProbeAdaptive: Caps next attempts based on the last successful amount.
settingsHints.rebalanceTimeout: Maximum runtime per rebalance job (auto or manual).
settingsHints.manualRestartWatch: When manual auto-restart is enabled on a channel, keep monitoring and restart if it falls below target after success.
settingsHints.manualRestartIgnoreEconomicGates: Conviction mode: manual-restart channels ignore the cost gate and ROI guardrail — keep filling them even without immediate economic return, because you're convinced they pay off over time. Fee cap (outgoing × econ ratio), cooldown, budget and operational limits still apply. Off by default (keeps the guardrailed behavior).
settingsHints.cooldownProbeEnabled: When enabled, periodically tests targets in cooldown with a small low-priority job. Off by default to avoid spending processing on low-yield probes.
settingsHints.mcHalfLife: Decay time for mission control failures. Lower values forget failures faster. 0 = leave LND default.
settingsHints.paybackMode: Unlock when routing revenue pays back the rebalance cost.
settingsHints.timeMode: Unlock after N days since last rebalance.
settingsHints.criticalMode: Allow partial release when sources are scarce.
settingsHints.unlockDays: Days before protected liquidity can be reused.
settingsHints.criticalRelease: Percent of protected liquidity released per critical cycle.
settingsHints.criticalMinSources: Minimum eligible sources required to avoid critical mode.
settingsHints.criticalMinAvailable: Minimum total source liquidity required to avoid critical mode.
settingsHints.criticalCycles: Number of consecutive critical scans before releasing.
settingsHints.rebalanceCostFloorPpm: Assumed cost ppm used when a target has no recent rebalance history. Channels are only eligible as targets when (spread × econ ratio) exceeds this floor.
settingsHints.sourceMinPaybackProgress: Minimum lifetime payback (forwarding revenue / rebalance cost) for a channel to qualify as source. Default 0.95 — channels must be near or above break-even before being drained again. Set to 0 to disable. Set to 1.0 for strict break-even. Channels with insignificant historical cost (under 500 sat) bypass this filter so freshly opened channels remain eligible.
settingsHints.missionControlReinforce: After every successful rebalance attempt, push positive history entries for each pair on the route into LND's Mission Control. Helps LND learn good paths faster and recover from MC poisoning. Off by default; enable if your node has chronic 'no path' errors despite known-good routes.
settingsHints.delegatedFastPath: Before iterating source-by-source, tries a single SendPaymentV2 call with ALL eligible sources and MPP enabled, letting LND's native pathfinder and Mission Control choose paths and shard the payment. On success, finalizes the job and skips the legacy loop. On failure, falls back to the source-by-source loop normally. Recommended in environments where you see 'no path' errors despite viable sources existing.
settingsHints.delegatedFastPathStrictPayback: When enabled, fast-path only passes sources whose post-payback free limit can cover the full rebalance amount. On by default when using aggressive source floors without draining protected liquidity.
settingsHints.freshPaidLiquidityLock: When enabled, liquidity purchased by rebalance stays protected for the configured window or until forwards consume it. Avoids A->B and then B->C immediately using freshly paid sats. On by default.
settingsHints.freshPaidLiquidityLockHours: Duration of the fresh paid liquidity lock. Default: 6h.

blockReasons.expected_profit_below_min: Score was considered, but expected profit remained below the configured minimum.
blockReasons.low_success_opportunity_below_floor: Blocked by the low-success opportunity floor.
blockReasons.budget_below_min: Score improved, but remaining budget could not fund the minimum execution amount.
blockReasons.budget_too_low: Blocked because the remaining daily budget was too low.
blockReasons.channel_busy: Blocked because this channel already had active work.

intentHelp.title: What is happening with {{alias}}?

kinds.refill_target: AutoFee detected that this channel is drained and published a request for Rebalance to consider replenishing its outbound liquidity.
kinds.protect_fee_floor: A recent successful rebalance created a temporary cost-protection floor so AutoFee does not immediately lower this channel's fee below the recovered cost basis. Upward fee moves remain allowed.

intentHelp.refillInfluenced: In the latest known evaluation, the Rebalance score changed from {{before}} to {{after}} sats. {{reason}}
intentHelp.waitingRebalanceScan: The signal is ready, but there is no Rebalance decision snapshot after the manager restart yet. The next scan will show whether it changes the ranking.
intentHelp.refillNotChanged: The signal was available but did not produce a measurable ranking change. {{reason}}
intentHelp.floorInfluenced: AutoFee consumed the protection while evaluating a downward fee move: {{before}} → {{after}} ppm.
intentHelp.waitingAutofeeDecision: The floor is active, but AutoFee has not yet recorded a downward decision that needed this protection.
intentHelp.stillSubjectToGates: The candidate still has to pass profit, ROI, budget, cooldown, source, and concurrency gates.
intentHelp.noMeasurableDelta: The confidence-adjusted multiplier may have rounded to the same score, or the candidate remained outside the applicable decision set.

modes.off: The interlock is off, so this signal is stored but cannot change an automation decision.
modes.shadow: Shadow mode calculates and records the hypothetical effect without changing the real decision.
modes.enforce: Enforce mode allows the signal to influence the consumer, but never bypasses that consumer's existing safety gates.

automationInterlock.advancedHint: Tune how intents enter the ranking and how the AutoFee settling window moderates that priority.
automationInterlock.combinedEffectHint: For the weakest admitted signal, both multipliers are applied in sequence for {{hours}} hour(s) after an AutoFee adjustment.
automationInterlock.settlingDisabledHint: Settling is disabled by a zero window or a 1.0 multiplier; only the intent boost is applied.
automationInterlock.intentAdmissionHint: Confidence controls which signals enter; the multiplier sets the maximum boost before other safeguards.
automationInterlock.settlingGuardrailHint: Temporarily reduces the score of channels whose fee was just adjusted by AutoFee. Use 1.0 for no reduction and a zero window to disable it.
automationInterlock.operationalWindowsHint: TTLs are service-defined and shown here for context only.
automationInterlock.saveCalibrationHint: Saves the intent configuration and the Rebalance settling safeguard together.
automationInterlock.historyHint: Publish, apply, and resolve events retained for audit and tuning.
